entities.name: Narset
entities.description: A human monk and former planeswalker from Tarkir, khan of the Jeskai Way and bound to the spirit dragon Shiko; a master of martial arts and mental discipline.

entities.name: Khan Narset (original timeline)
entities.description: The original-timeline Narset, khan of the Jeskai Way, who is killed by Zurgo Helmsmasher while guarding Sarkhan's passage to Ugin's Nexus.

entities.name: Shiko
entities.description: A spirit dragon Narset called into being, shaped by her beliefs.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: A dragonlord who took Narset on as a student and later blessed her search for knowledge.

entities.name: Taigam
entities.description: Narset's peer and former pupil (depending on timeline) who confronts her and labels her a heretic.

entities.name: Shintan
entities.description: Narset's bodyguard in the original timeline, more loyal to the Jeskai elders than to her.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who seeks Ugin on Tarkir; later desparked, he becomes an enormous dragon and takes control of wild dragons.

entities.name: Zurgo Helmsmasher
entities.description: A maddened orc who kills Narset at Ugin's Tomb in the original timeline.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A spirit dragon from whom all dragons were formed, Tarkir's soul, devoted to keeping his brother contained.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon sealed in the Meditation Realm who escapes after Jace's spell.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: An angelic planeswalker who questions Narset about dragonstorms and travels with her.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who casts a spell to recreate the Multiverse, which fails and unmakes him.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: A creature who accompanies Jace and is carried to safety by Narset.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Disappears with Loot during the fight at the Stormplains temple.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who warns Narset about Sarkhan and arrives to help the Abzan.

entities.name: Felothar
entities.description: An Abzan khan whose forces help hold Sarkhan off.

entities.name: Alniul
aliases: the Twice Whisperer of the Temur
entities.description: A Temur whisperer who helps Narset uncover the Stormnexus Ritual scroll.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A planeswalker whose Story-Circle on Kamigawa Narset has joined.

entities.name: Chandra
entities.description: A planeswalker who disabled the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Jeskai Way
entities.description: The clan of Tarkir of which Narset is khan and later Waymaster.

entities.name: Dragonlords
entities.description: Elder dragons who ruled Tarkir and are defeated through the Stormnexus Ritual.

entities.name: Abzan Houses
entities.description: A clan whose forces fight Sarkhan's wild dragons.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: A group of planeswalkers fighting Bolas on Ravnica.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: Narset's home plane, ruled by dragonlords and later struck by dragonstorms.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: A plane where Narset seeks peace.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Narset is trapped during the invasion of Bolas.

entities.name: Ikoria
entities.description: A plane where Narset sought enlightenment after her confrontation with Bolas.

entities.name: Meditation Realm
entities.description: A shifting realm reached by a ragged Omenpath where Ugin and Bolas are sealed.

entities.name: Stormnexus Ritual
entities.description: A ritual to call forth the soul of Tarkir that summons five spirit dragons and defeats the dragonlords.

entities.name: Dragonstorms
entities.description: Storms reactivated by the ritual that spawn wild dragons and make places uninhabitable.

entities.name: Spirit dragons
entities.description: Five untethered spirit dragons that emerge from the dragonstorm and bind to the new clan leaders.

entities.name: Desparkening
entities.description: The event after the New Phyrexian Invasion in which Narset lost her spark.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion from which Narset returned to defend Tarkir.

events.summary: In the original timeline, a Kirin guides Narset to the suffering Sarkhan Vol, whom she calms and agrees to bring to Ugin's Tomb.
events.quote: Narset was approached by a Kirin which guided her to the suffering Sarkhan Vol

events.summary: At Ugin's Tomb, Zurgo attacks Sarkhan; Narset fights him but is distracted and killed while urging Sarkhan into the Nexus of Fate.
events.quote: she was distracted by Sarkhan which enabled Zurgo to land a killing blow

events.summary: In the new timeline, Ojutai notices young Narset and takes her on as a student.
events.quote: so she was taken on as a student

events.summary: Narset discovers that Tarkir was not always ruled by dragons and learns of Ugin.
events.quote: it was not always a world ruled by dragons as the teachings of Ojutai claimed

events.summary: Taigam confronts Narset, who overpowers him and escapes; he labels her a heretic.
events.quote: Narset overpowered him and made her escape

events.summary: Narset's planeswalker spark ignites as she learns the truth of Tarkir's past, but she stays on Tarkir.
events.quote: Her planeswalker's spark ignited while she learned the truth about Tarkir's past

events.summary: Narset admits her discovery to Ojutai, who gives her his blessing to keep seeking knowledge.
events.quote: gave her his blessings and encouraged her to continue seeking knowledge and enlightenment

events.summary: Narset is lured to Ravnica by the Interplanar Beacon, trapped by Bolas's Immortal Sun, and fights the Eternals of the Dreadhorde.
events.quote: Narset was lured to Ravnica by the Interplanar Beacon

events.summary: Narset spends time on Ikoria seeking enlightenment after confronting Bolas.
events.quote: Narset spent some indeterminate amount of time on Ikoria

events.summary: Narset returns to defend Tarkir from the New Phyrexian Invasion and afterward loses her spark in the Desparkening.
events.quote: she lost her spark in the Desparkening

events.summary: With Alniul's help Narset uncovers the Stormnexus Ritual scroll and, persuaded by rebellion leaders, agrees to use it.
events.quote: convinced by the other rebellion leaders that this was the best way to ensure a unified Tarkir

events.summary: The ritual calls up a massive dragonstorm from which five spirit dragons emerge and bind to the clan leaders; the dragonlords are defeated and swallowed by the storm.
events.quote: the dragonlords were defeated by the clan leaders and their spirit dragons

events.summary: The ritual also reactivates dragonstorms, spawning wild dragons and making places uninhabitable.
events.quote: the spell had also reactivated the dragonstorms

events.summary: Narset is appointed Waymaster of the Jeskai after the dragonlords' defeat.
events.quote: Narset was appointed Waymaster of the Jeskai.

events.summary: Elspeth questions Narset about dragonstorms, helps her defeat attacking dragons at the Jeskai monastery, and they travel to the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon where Elspeth defeats Sarkhan.
events.quote: Sarkhan engaged Elspeth in battle but his desparked form was no match for the archangel and he was quickly defeated.

events.summary: At Felothar's court, Ajani warns them that Sarkhan has become an enormous dragon controlling the wild dragons.
events.quote: Sarkhan Vol had taken the form of an enormous dragon

events.summary: Narset and Elspeth find a temple housing an Omenpath to the Meditation Realm and meet Jace and Loot.
events.quote: they happened on Jace Beleren and the creature Loot

events.summary: Narset empties her mind so the Realm takes true form, revealing the two sealed elder dragons.
events.quote: used a meditative technique to empty her mind, allowing the plane to assume its true form

events.summary: Ugin refuses to help quell the dragonstorms; Jace's spell to recreate the Multiverse fails, unmaking reality and Jace, and the others escape.
events.quote: As it failed, it revealed a void that poured toward them, unmaking reality — Jace included.

events.summary: At the Stormplains temple, Narset, Elspeth and the Abzan fight Sarkhan's wild dragons; Ugin appears and defeats Sarkhan with ghostfire, though Bolas has escaped.
events.quote: Ugin appeared and immediately defeated Sarkhan with his ghostfire
